en:
What's wrong? Did you need something 
from me?
<CLT=cltMIND>Should I hang out with Tsumugi for a while?

Ah, sure. I don't really have anything 
to do anyway.
Well, since we've got this opportunity...

Why don't you show me your research 
lab, Shuichi? I heard it was pretty nice.

<CLT=cltMIND>I spent some time with Tsumugi
in my lab.
<CLT=cltMIND>Tsumugi and I grew a little closer today.
